description: Shows the exact message that `messages_send` would send to one dealership, and sends nothing. It answers with the text as the dealership would get it, how it would be sent (`sms` or `email`), whether it can be sent now, and a `previewToken` that is valid for 15 minutes and only for this exact text, this row and this `idempotencyKey`.

askId.description: Optional. The `askId` of the dealership's question this message answers, from a message in `messages_list` that carries one. Leave it out if the message answers no question. The preview and the send take the same `askId`.

dealSetId.description: The id of the request, from requests_list.

idempotencyKey.description: A key made up for this one message. The preview and the send take the same key; sending the same key again returns the first answer.

text.description: The message text, as the buyer wants it said to the dealership.

name: messages_preview
title: Preview a message
